metadata.dcterms:title: On the Gram determinants of the Specht modules
metadata.dcterms:creator: Hoyer, Linda
metadata.dcterms:abstract: For every partition λ of a positive integer n, let Sλ be the corresponding Specht module of the symmetric group Sn, and let det(λ) ∈Z denote the Gram determinant of the canonical bilinear form with respect to the standard basis of Sλ. Writing det(λ) = m · 2a(2) λ for integers a(2) λ and m with m odd, we show that if the dimension of Sλ is even, then a(2) λ is also even. This confirms a conjecture posed by Richard Parker in the special case of the symmetric groups.
